svg.text: Every code the upstream authority has retired since 2005, and whether the permanent registry below it kept the name.
the import: ISO 639-3 enters the registry, and
everything it had already retired stays out
'Gugu Mini' — retired as non-existent in 2014, five years inside the
period the registry does remember, and missing all the same: never
added at all, on a tip that it was going to be retired.
Registry file-date 2026-08-08: 9296 records, 302 deprecated, none ever removed.
The 162 absences are not removals. The names were never entered.
